provenance.artifact: Linux Bedrock Dedicated Server 1.26.52.3 (bedrock_server, minecraft.net), run on our own machine with server-authoritative-movement-strict=true, player-position-acceptance-threshold=0.0001, online-mode=false; positions read from its CorrectPlayerMovePrediction packets to a headless client
notes: tick i is the server's state after it processed input i; each trace was replayed from the same start with the same inputs until every tick had been corrected

the client sent PlayerAuthInput at 20 Hz with input mode mouse, play mode normal, interaction model crosshair, the move vector also as the analogue and raw move vectors, camera orientation from yaw and pitch, and a zero delta
